name: io.github.Ilya-a-sergeyev-ger/krauncher-mcp
title: Krauncher analyzer
description: Pre-run cost estimate for a GPU task from static analysis of the code — compute/setup/io seconds on a reference card, VRAM/disk needs, and what the analyzer read. The code is never executed.

environmentVariables.name: CAS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Krauncher API key for the analyzer (get one at https://krauncher.com). The server runs locally and calls the analyzer with this key.
